fresh_comparison_method: Load the original committed gateway, plugin and Cargo baseline constructors against the same current package set and source root. Only relative loading paths are rewritten for the temporary original files. Default Cargo baseline rendering is also compared independently.
limits: Derivation equality proves unchanged construction; it does not claim every historical output is realized.
Release Cargo comparison and the public production selector are qualified separately.
No compiler/linker semantic equivalence, live QEMU execution, foreign execution, performance acceptance or production default cutover is claimed.
